Record Class InvocationPlan

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.core.InvocationPlan
Record Components:
kind - The instruction
ownerDescriptor - The descriptor of the type the instruction names
name - The name of the method
descriptor - The descriptor of the method, returning what its declaration does
ownerInterface - Whether the owner is an interface, as the constant pool entry of the method says
receiver - What happens to the receiver once it is written
receiverCast - The descriptor of the type the receiver is cast to, for InvocationPlan.Receiver.CAST
method - The invoked method, in the scope of the class declaring it
values - The arguments, converted to the parameters of the method
result - The conversion of the result to the type the call requests, if any
@Internal public record InvocationPlan(InvocationPlan.Kind kind, String ownerDescriptor, String name, String descriptor, boolean ownerInterface, InvocationPlan.Receiver receiver, @Nullable String receiverCast, MethodDef method, List<? extends ExpressionDef> values, @Nullable InvocationPlan.ResultConversion result) extends Record
An invocation as both bytecode writers emit it, planned once: the instruction and what it names - the owner, the descriptor with the return type the method declares, whether the owner is an interface - what happens to the receiver, the parameters the arguments are converted to, and the conversion of the result to the type the call requests. A writer only writes the receiver and the arguments, and emits the plan.
Since:
2.3

  • Method Details

    • ofInstance

      public static InvocationPlan ofInstance(ExpressionDef instance, MethodDef method, List<? extends ExpressionDef> values, @Nullable ObjectDef current, @Nullable MethodDef enclosing)
      The call of a method on a value.
      • A method the receiver does not declare - on this or super, of a variable named alone - or one the class being written does not access is resolved where the call is written.
      • A receiver of a type variable is the bound declaring the method, cast to where it is not the erasure.
      • The method is erased in the scope of the class declaring it, whose variables the caller's can shadow.
      • A static method called through a value is invoked statically, the value evaluated and discarded, as javac does.
      • A call on super is dispatched non-virtually against the supertype, which names an interface method for Interface.super.name(); a call on an interface is invokeinterface, even of a default method.
      • A call requesting another type than its method declares invokes the declaration, and converts what it returns, as javac does: a primitive requested of a generic return unboxes the wrapper the call returns.
      Parameters:
      instance - The receiver
      method - The method
      values - The arguments
      current - The definition being written, if any
      enclosing - The method being written, if any
      Returns:
      The plan

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
